00101|       throw new Error(`Geocoding failed: ${response.statusText}`);

00104|     const data = await response.json();
00105|     
00106|     if (data.status !== 'OK' || !data.results.length) {
00107|       console.error('Geocoding failed:', data.status, data.error_message);
00108|       return null;
00109|     }
00110|     
00111|     const location = data.results[0].geometry.location;

00113|   } catch (error) {

00119| // Search venues using Google Places API
00120| export async function searchGooglePlaces(params: SearchParams): Promise<VenueData[]> {

00461| // Calculate distance between two points in miles
00462| function calculateDistance(lat1: number, lon1: number, lat2: number, lon2: number): number {
00463|   const R = 3959; // Earth's radius in miles
00464|   const dLat = toRadians(lat2 - lat1);
00465|   const dLon = toRadians(lon2 - lon1);
00466|   const a = 
00467|     Math.sin(dLat/2) * Math.sin(dLat/2) +
00468|     Math.cos(toRadians(lat1)) * Math.cos(toRadians(lat2)) * 
00469|     Math.sin(dLon/2) * Math.sin(dLon/2);
00470|   const c = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1-a));
00471|   const distance = R * c;
00472|   return distance;
00473| }
00474| 
00475| function toRadians(degrees: number): number {
00476|   return degrees * (Math.PI / 180);
00477| }
